::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 18th [?1893]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Harry Ransom Humanities Research Center, University of Texas, Austin
:::

My dear Mary
I came home from Salisbury yesterday afternoon, and tried to answer your note, but could not finish. I will keep your card and see if I can give the case a vote.

I am going to stay with [Frances](people/person_1604.qmd) next week from Monday to Saturday

Your affectionate
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Dated on the assumption that it post-dates Frances Yonge’s move to 70 Kensington Gardens Square in 1892.
